notes: 24 country bags x 20 foods (10 healthy grade A/B + 10 'sometimes' grade D/E) = 480 foods. v0.3 adds Indonesia, Russia, Ukraine, Philippines (one per added language). Starter Bag in PIKKO-GAME-DESIGN.md section 8.
Traditional sweets, fried street food and party dishes are 'sometimes foods', never 'bad' foods: present them with respect.
kcal values are APPROXIMATE per typical portion and must be verified (USDA FoodData Central / CREA / IZZ / national tables) and reviewed by a paediatric nutritionist.
Grades are the internal Pikko Score, not the official Nutri-Score.
Polish names need native-speaker review. Local dish names are kept where they are the common name.
Logos use colour palettes inspired by each country, not flags or national emblems (some countries restrict commercial use of flags).
mint is null until the developer supplies the Pump.fun CA and it passes Token-2022 / extension / route verification.

fact.it: Italia: la dieta mediterranea — verdure, legumi, olio d'oliva e pasta — è patrimonio UNESCO.
fact.pl: Włochy: dieta śródziemnomorska — warzywa, strączki, oliwa i makaron — jest dziedzictwem UNESCO.

fact.en: Poland: pickles and sauerkraut are fermented winter classics, full of friendly bacteria.
fact.it: Polonia: cetrioli e crauti fermentati sono classici dell'inverno, pieni di batteri buoni.
fact.pl: Polska: kiszone ogórki i kapusta to zimowa klasyka pełna dobrych bakterii.

fact.en: Japan: washoku — rice, miso soup, fish and vegetables — is UNESCO heritage (2013).
fact.it: Giappone: il washoku — riso, zuppa di miso, pesce e verdure — è patrimonio UNESCO (2013).
fact.pl: Japonia: washoku — ryż, zupa miso, ryby i warzywa — jest dziedzictwem UNESCO (2013).

fact.en: Mexico: traditional Mexican cuisine is UNESCO heritage (2010) — corn, beans and chili at its heart.
fact.it: Messico: la cucina tradizionale messicana è patrimonio UNESCO (2010) — mais, fagioli e peperoncino al centro.
fact.pl: Meksyk: tradycyjna kuchnia meksykańska jest dziedzictwem UNESCO (2010) — kukurydza, fasola i chili.

fact.en: USA: corn, beans and squash — the 'Three Sisters' — were grown together by Native American farmers.
fact.it: Stati Uniti: mais, fagioli e zucca — le 'Tre Sorelle' — erano coltivati insieme dai popoli nativi.
fact.pl: USA: kukurydza, fasola i dynia — „Trzy Siostry” — uprawiano razem u rdzennych Amerykanów.

fact.en: India: many dishes are built on lentils (dal) and spices like turmeric and cumin.
fact.it: India: tanti piatti nascono da lenticchie (dal) e spezie come curcuma e cumino.
fact.pl: Indie: wiele potraw opiera się na soczewicy (dal) i przyprawach jak kurkuma i kumin.

fact.en: France: the French gastronomic meal is UNESCO heritage (2010) — starter, main, cheese, dessert.
fact.it: Francia: il pasto gastronomico francese è patrimonio UNESCO (2010) — antipasto, piatto, formaggio, dolce.
fact.pl: Francja: francuski posiłek gastronomiczny jest dziedzictwem UNESCO (2010) — przystawka, danie, ser, deser.

fact.en: Spain: the world's biggest producer of olive oil — the base of Mediterranean cooking.
fact.it: Spagna: è il primo produttore mondiale di olio d'oliva, base della cucina mediterranea.
fact.pl: Hiszpania: największy producent oliwy na świecie — podstawy kuchni śródziemnomorskiej.

fact.en: Greece: a real Greek salad has no lettuce — tomato, cucumber, onion, olives and feta.
fact.it: Grecia: la vera insalata greca non ha lattuga — pomodoro, cetriolo, cipolla, olive e feta.
fact.pl: Grecja: prawdziwa sałatka grecka nie ma sałaty — pomidor, ogórek, cebula, oliwki i feta.

fact.en: Türkiye: red lentil soup (mercimek çorbası) is a warm everyday classic.
fact.it: Turchia: la zuppa di lenticchie rosse (mercimek çorbası) è un classico di tutti i giorni.
fact.pl: Turcja: zupa z czerwonej soczewicy (mercimek çorbası) to codzienna klasyka.

fact.en: China: steaming is one of the oldest cooking methods — it keeps flavour with very little oil.
fact.it: Cina: la cottura al vapore è tra le più antiche — conserva il gusto con pochissimo olio.
fact.pl: Chiny: gotowanie na parze to jedna z najstarszych metod — zachowuje smak przy minimum oleju.

fact.en: Korea: kimjang — making kimchi together for winter — is UNESCO heritage (2013).
fact.it: Corea: il kimjang — preparare insieme il kimchi per l'inverno — è patrimonio UNESCO (2013).
fact.pl: Korea: kimjang — wspólne robienie kimchi na zimę — jest dziedzictwem UNESCO (2013).

fact.en: Thailand: Thai cooking balances four tastes — sour, sweet, salty and spicy.
fact.it: Thailandia: la cucina thai bilancia quattro sapori — aspro, dolce, salato e piccante.
fact.pl: Tajlandia: kuchnia tajska łączy cztery smaki — kwaśny, słodki, słony i ostry.

fact.en: Vietnam: meals come with a plate of fresh herbs — mint, basil, coriander — to add yourself.
fact.it: Vietnam: i pasti arrivano con un piatto di erbe fresche — menta, basilico, coriandolo — da aggiungere.
fact.pl: Wietnam: do posiłku podaje się talerz świeżych ziół — mięty, bazylii, kolendry.

fact.en: Brazil: rice and beans (arroz com feijão) are eaten almost every day — a perfect protein team.

fact.en: Peru: thousands of potato varieties grow in the Andes — the potato comes from here.

fact.en: Morocco: couscous is UNESCO heritage (2020), shared by Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia and Mauritania.
fact.it: Marocco: il couscous è patrimonio UNESCO (2020), condiviso da Marocco, Algeria, Tunisia e Mauritania.
fact.pl: Maroko: kuskus jest dziedzictwem UNESCO (2020), wspólnym dla Maroka, Algierii, Tunezji i Mauretanii.

fact.en: United Kingdom: tea is the favourite drink — try it with milk and no sugar.

fact.en: Germany: hundreds of kinds of bread — wholegrain rye is a fibre champion.

fact.pl: Niemcy: setki rodzajów chleba — razowy żytni to mistrz błonnika.
